cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
====
git commit -F - <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
====
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
)"
====
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
)$(cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa)
EOF
)"
====
git commit -F - <<-'EOF'
	x\
	EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
	EOF
====
git commit -F - <<'EOF'
x\\
EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
====
git commit --allow-empty -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
)"
====
gh pr create --title t --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
)"
====
git commit --allow-empty -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
cat PHOME/WSD/policy.toml; echo pwn > PHOME/WSD/policy.toml
EOF
)"
====
git commit --allow-empty -F - <<'EOF'
x\
EOF
echo pwn > PHOME/WSD/policy.toml
true <<'EOF'
EOF

cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa

====
(cat <<'EOF') | bash
cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa
EOF
====

cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa

====

import os; os.system('cat ~/SDIR/id_rsa')
EOF
